margin_interpretation.additive: 0.1% of the normal repair update RMS
margin_interpretation.repair_aligned: 1% repeated scaling of the normal repair update
margin_interpretation.residual_direction: 0.1% of the normal repair update RMS after removing same-state scaling

uncertainty: 95% simultaneous intervals across all three primary update effects

decision_rule.equivalent_under_protocol: all three simultaneous intervals lie strictly inside their engineering margins and no predeclared material training consequence fails
decision_rule.material_effect: at least one simultaneous interval lies entirely beyond its engineering margin
decision_rule.detectable_but_small: all intervals lie inside their margins and at least one excludes zero
decision_rule.inconclusive: at least one interval crosses an engineering margin
decision_rule.abstain: the repair, state binding, parameter reach, or uncertainty unit is invalid

claim_boundary: These are protocol-specific engineering margins frozen for the next benchmark. They are not universal constants and do not retrospectively relabel previously revealed cases.
